intro.title: Map, Set, WeakMap & Symbols
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple contact list application to manage names and phone numbers. You will learn how to use JavaScript's Map to store key-value pairs, Set to handle unique values like email addresses, WeakMap for memory-efficient references, and Symbols to create unique identifiers. These modern data structures help you write cleaner and more efficient code. By the end, you'll understand when and how to apply each of these constructs in real-world scenarios.
intro.usecase: In modern web applications, Map and Set are essential for managing dynamic data relationships, such as tracking user selections in a multi-select filter panel or storing unique items in a shopping cart. WeakMap is used for private data storage in libraries, associating metadata with DOM elements without causing memory leaks. Symbols provide unique keys for object properties, preventing naming collisions in large-scale applications like dashboards with multiple third-party plugins. These data structures help developers write more efficient, maintainable, and memory-safe code in real-world scenarios like interactive data visualizations and complex state management.
